blocks.text: 今天，我们正式推出 MiniMax M3.1 Flash。
Space Bunny 🐰 在匿名运行期间处理了超过 200 万亿个 token，它是 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 的早期版本。

blocks.text: 作为新一代 Flash 模型，M3.1 Flash 在智能体任务、编程、Computer Use 和网络安全方面实现了代际跃升，同时将在线推理速度提升近三倍，并将使用成本降低 70%。

inlines.text: 作为新一代 Flash 模型，M3.1 Flash 在智能体任务、编程、Computer Use 和网络安全方面实现了代际跃升，同时将在线推理速度提升近三倍，并将使用成本降低 70%。

blocks.text: M3.1 Flash 在广泛的基准测试中均有提升，在复杂智能体任务（cowork）、计算机使用、软件开发（编程）和网络安全方面达到领先模型水平。

inlines.text: M3.1 Flash 在广泛的基准测试中均有提升，在复杂智能体任务（cowork）、计算机使用、软件开发（编程）和网络安全方面达到领先模型水平。
M3.1 Flash 在 AutomationBench-AA 上位列顶尖表现者之列。它能够跨 SaaS 系统完成真实企业工作流，端到端解决销售、营销、运营、客户服务、财务和人力资源中的实际问题。
在 BankerToolBench 上得分 76.2，擅长应对多步规划、跨文档和文件保持一致、财务合规以及链式工具调用等复杂的现实挑战。
它在 DeepSWE v1.1 上达到 73.7%，跻身顶尖模型之列。DeepSWE 聚焦复杂软件任务，要求模型独立理解代码、开发功能、修复问题并通过测试验证工作。M3.1 Flash 在长序列步骤中展现出强大的执行能力，以更低成本支持复杂软件开发工作流。
它在衡量 AI 计算机操作与跨应用任务执行的 OSWorld V2 上得分 61.7 分，在评估真实专业工作和复杂任务表现的 Agents’ Last Exam（ALE）上得分 29.6 分。它在这两项基准上均位列中国模型第一。
M3.1 Flash 在与真实环境交互、使用工具和执行长序列任务方面展现出强大能力——不止于理解任务，更能采取行动并交付结果。
它在 CyberGym 上取得 82% 的优异成绩，在漏洞发现与验证方面展现出领先能力。
在我们内部安全专家的深度评估中，该模型在代码审计、漏洞修补、渗透测试、恶意软件分析和逆向工程方面表现强劲，能够高效、低成本地支持构建复杂安全系统。

blocks.text: Today, we officially roll out MiniMax M3.1 Flash.
Space Bunny 🐰, which processed more than 200 trillion tokens while operating anonymously, was an early version of MiniMax M3.1 Flash.

blocks.text: As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.

inlines.text: As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.

blocks.text: M3.1 Flash improves across a broad range of benchmarks, reaching the level of leading models in complex agentic tasks (cowork), computer use, software development (coding), and cybersecurity.

inlines.text: M3.1 Flash improves across a broad range of benchmarks, reaching the level of leading models in complex agentic tasks (cowork), computer use, software development (coding), and cybersecurity.

M3.1 Flash ranks among the top performers on AutomationBench-AA. It can complete real enterprise workflows across SaaS systems, solving practical problems in sales, marketing, operations, customer service, finance, and HR from end to end.

Scoring 76.2 on BankerToolBench, it excels at complex real-world challenges such as multi-step planning, maintaining consistency across documents and files, financial compliance, and chained tool calls.

It achieves 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, placing it alongside top models. DeepSWE focuses on complex software tasks that require models to independently understand code, develop features, fix issues, and validate their work through testing. M3.1 Flash demonstrates strong execution across long sequences of steps, supporting complex software development workflows at a lower cost.

It scores 61.7 points on OSWorld V2, which measures AI computer operation and cross-application task execution, and 29.6 points on Agents’ Last Exam (ALE), which evaluates performance on real professional work and complex tasks. It ranks first among Chinese models on both benchmarks.

M3.1 Flash demonstrates strong capabilities in interacting with real environments, using tools, and executing long sequences of tasks—moving beyond understanding a task to taking action and delivering results.
It achieves a strong score of 82% on CyberGym, demonstrating leading capabilities in vulnerability discovery and validation.

In in-depth evaluations by our internal security experts, the model performed strongly in code auditing, vulnerability patching, penetration testing, malware analysis, and reverse engineering, enabling efficient, low-cost support for building complex security systems.
